title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX

info.about: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX is a 1998 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Color. The game is a colorized version of the 1993 Game Boy title The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening, in which protagonist Link must fight monsters, explore dungeons and solve puzzles to escape from Koholint Island.
